name: Licata (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Licata (a castle above the sea on blue) on a black eagle, within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Licata, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 7 December 1939.

features.role: Licata arms — castle above the sea on blue, on a black eagle, within branches
